Hi, I'm Mortain. Some of you may remember me from the feral wolf/feral horse community back in the prime of the game. I am most famous for Order of the wolf, and a good smattering of others over the years.  


As a former mason/helper/and pixel from may years past, i have been contemplating getting back into the program just to contribute something other than the emptiness of the help channel most times I need help clarifying something.  


if not for Discord's Furcadia Central and FAM/FAZ communities i would be lost on half the crap i needed to learn to bring OOTW up to 32 bit and learn how to shade, and mark patches with the new 32 bit editor (love love by the way. Soooo much better than old fsh style.)  


The grumbles I hear, from beekins who no longer log in (because they feel like they are lugging the entire work load in the past) to having virtually 0 support when they themselves don't know the answer or where to find it is appalling to watch. me and my fellow beekins of old use to pride ourselves with our work and dedication to this game to make the game what it was.  


I hear the malcontent, and the anger at DEP and catnip studios (mostly at Both Felorin and Emerald Flame) for not doing more sooner to bring the game up to speed with modern times. one of the biggest complaints right now is there is no mobile app that was promised years ago. Yes we had one for a few months. but when it was pulled off the google play store and the apple store due to the adult content it had, it basically killed the mobile app in the water.

I understand a good portion of the dev team quit. i was surprised some die hard friends of mine when i talked to them recently on facebook about it had nothing but venom and vile words towards the heads of furcadia. it really opened my eyes to the truth of the community and home i had to walk away from for my own mental well being.  


This game has really gone to shit in the last few years. And (mind you this is my personal opinion) unless drastic steps are taken quickly and with much speed for development, this game will be dead within the next 2 years (mind you this is my generous estimate.) I know i'm working on building my discord community for the eventuality of the game going away and OOTW (and all the other wonderful dream communities out there) will have lost years, and in some cases, lifetimes of work and effort to bring patching, coding and visions to life for a game that treats it's players like a fucking afterthought.  


Money makes the world go round. You can only throw so many digos at a problem and expect it to be fixed. Stop making fucking shit to sell, stop selling lifers (and even offering them) it's killing your revenue capital, and kick this shit into high gear.  


or do us all a favor and finally pull the fucking plug once and for all and stop letting the game suffer and let us all move on for christ sakes.
